method: read-only copies of live ARM ELF executables; ordinary Python ELF parsing and Capstone disassembly, not REA decompilation

findings.observation: getpwnam resolves Unix account; admin account password is replaced with an embedded literal before authentication. Literal and account hashes omitted.
Password auth compares plaintext length and bytes to the in-memory password; helper XORs/ORs differences. No crypt transform on this path.
UID zero uses /etc/dropbear/authorized_keys and checks directory/file ownership and no group/other write. Nonzero UID uses home/.ssh/authorized_keys.

ServiceSSH Enable and Port control launch; initialization invokes mkdir and dropbearkey in /var/dropbear; service launch uses -r /var/dropbear/rsa_host_key and numeric -p ports; stop/update paths use killall dropbear.
